title: MacroPulse Alert
message: BTC ETF -$65.4M outflow Mon (IBIT-only) — selling resumes after Oct 12 easing narrative. BlackRock cuts US equities to neutral; upgrades short-Treasuries to OW. IMF flags surging bond yields as biggest risk to global financial system. BTC ~$83,400. Sep CPI prints tomorrow 08:30 ET (est. 3.7% headline).
